research_session: Production-008; research started October 1; resumed October 12 without reselection

fr-monstre.scope: MONSTRE, Académie 9e: XII century, Latin monstrum; modern senses including monstre sacré.

en-monster.scope: Middle English/Anglo-French/Latin transmission; noun first-known 14th century, adjective 1837, sense-specific.

fr-presser.scope: TLFi PRESSER: ca1160 torment, ca1200 olives/crowd; 1557 urgency. Latin pressare intensive of premere. Accessed via inflected URL.

fr-pression.scope: PRESSION: XIII century, Latin pressio from pressum/premere; modern physical and technical pressure.

en-recognize.scope: Anglo-French reconois-/reconoistre and Latin recognoscere. 1537 first-known formal acknowledgement sense, not all senses.

fr-reconnaitre.scope: TLFi RECONNAÎTRE accessible inflected entry: Latin recognoscere, late 10th-century reconnostre; identification, acknowledgement, gratitude constructions.

lumen.scope: Lewis & Short lūmen: classical light/lamp and transferred clarity senses; Cic. Div. 2.42.91; De orat. 2.86.353. Lexicographic order is not dated chronology.

lux.scope: Lewis & Short lux: sunlight/day; Cic. Div. 1.3.6; Caes. BG 1.22; public view and life. Retrieved via urllib after browser extraction failure; not the SI unit.

怪: 古壞切；数字音系表见母怪韵去声
怪异不必邪恶；古文字材料未核验
妖: 《说文》𡝩卷十二：巧也；女子笑貌，从女芺聲；段注区分䄏。
不能把笑貌排成妖怪的已证演变；字形关系 Pending
兆: 《说文》𠧞卷三：龟灼裂占卜；兆为省形。
仅比 omen，不是现代 monster 普通翻译；排除数词
按: 查考等义不等于 PRESS；字形解释未作现代古文字核验
迫: 《说文》卷二：近也，从辵白聲；《康熙》引《广韵》急也及《前汉书》外迫公事。
近与急的辞书义序不能确定 chronology；排除 pǎi
挤: 《说文》擠卷十二：排也，从手齊聲；段注引排而坠。
子計切；完整中古分析 Pending
认: 《康熙》認引《玉篇》识认、《增韵》辨识及《后汉书》卓茂认马。
而振切／而證切；日母震／证韵去声
辨认与承认早期次序未核；不声称说文已收認
识: 《说文》識卷三：常也，一曰知也，从言戠聲；段注对常字有校释争议。
排除 zhì；校勘争议未裁定
谢: 《说文》謝及段注：辞去；拜赐曰谢为另一层说明，从言射聲。
仅比感激构式，不覆盖辨认；不按注释顺序定年
光: 《说文》卷十：明也，火在人上为传统构形解释。
古皇切／古黃切；见母唐韵平声
传统构形不是原始字形已证；L hypothesis 没有因此得到验证
明: 《说文》朙卷七：照也，从月囧；明为另一字形。
不能把日月当所有字形唯一来源；亮与理解不自动构成已证 chronology
灯: 燈／灯／鐙须分开；网页说文转列鐙，不能直接当现代灯起源证据。
中古燈的专门条目 Pending
古音及器具字形关系 Pending；仅保留现代灯具语义
昼: 《说文》晝卷三：与夜分界，从畫省、从日。
陟救切；完整中古/上古重建 Pending
只比 DAY，不覆盖 light 全义
压: 《说文》壓卷十三：壞也／塞補，从土厭聲；段注讨论壓／厭区别。
烏狎切；音系表烏甲切，影母狎韵入声
不能把现代压力／压强术语倒推到此条
压力: 复合词首见及抽象扩展定年 Pending；壓字史不能代替压力词史。
复合词历史读音不从单字拼造
物理压力不是单位面积的压强
压强: 现代科学术语；译名形成及首见资料 Pending。
不适用社会压力；不能倒投 Latin pressio

stages: abnormal or fabulous creature; cruel person; exceptional figure
entries.counterexample: monstre sacré 可指受推崇艺人，不等于恶魔。
entries.analysis: Latin omen ↔ 兆为历史单位比较；怪／妖仅覆盖局部现代义。

stages: Middle English transmission; English noun 14th century
creature / cruel person / exceptionally large or successful thing
entries.counterexample: monster hit 不表示邪恶；不得继承 French monstre 的结论。
entries.analysis: 英语现代义独立审查；复用 Latin 节点，不复用 Featured。

stages: press / compress / harass; intensive of premere
torment ca1160; press olives / crowd ca1200
apply pressure / urge / be urgent / hurry
entries.scope: 催迫／紧迫 only; excludes squeezing fruit, buttons and crowding
entries.counterexample: presser un citron 不能译迫柠檬；所列约1160抽象记录早于约1200榨取记录。
entries.analysis: 迫仅作为催迫／紧迫摘要；按为施力、挤为挤压，分别保存。

stages: 1537 first-known formal acknowledgement; modern senses coexist
identify a previously known entity / acknowledge formally
entries.scope: identify a previously known entity / acknowledge; excludes unrestricted specialized constructions
entries.counterexample: recognize a speaker 的程序性许可不能一概译认；谢不是英语 recognize 的标准对应。
entries.analysis: 认是限定现代结构摘要，识为 KNOW/identify 比较；谢降为语义 control，不入 shortlist。

stages: recall / review; later acknowledgement and rights usage
entries.counterexample: reconnaissant 的感激义、侦察义不能统一译认；不继承英语 Featured。
entries.analysis: 辨识、承认、感激按构式分开；谢仅对应 gratitude 层，历史桥梁 Pending。

stages: Classical citations collected by Lewis & Short
Classical transferred senses; chronology not established
entries.counterexample: Latin lūmen 不是 SI 流明；灯是光源，不等于所有 light。
entries.analysis: 光／明／灯分别比光照、明晰、照明器物；trop. 标签不等于时间箭头。

entries.counterexample: Latin lux 不是 SI 勒克斯；昼只比 DAY；L 命中不能支持 L→光 假说。
entries.analysis: 复用 lumen 的词典资源，独立处理 DAY/PUBLIC VIEW；不构造 lux→lumen→lumière 单线。

stages: Latin noun and verbal base, not three semantic stages
pressing; force per surface area in physics; social/psychological pressure
entries.counterexample: 物理 pression 常须译压强；压力／压强不可无条件互换；古壓不能证明术语史。
entries.analysis: 压为动作比较，压力为抽象负担，压强为技术量，不合并为一个历史单位。

method_limits: Mainland-first access via 汉典 does not make embedded dictionary transcriptions independently checked Mainland print evidence.
Every Old Chinese reconstruction remains Pending; fanqie/rhyme labels are documentary leads, not reconstructed IPA.
Phonetic expansion was not run as a systematic retrieval experiment in this bounded depth run. Do not report zero retained as experimental efficacy.
Featured proposals are new editorial recommendations, not automatically inherited or approved.
family_reuse: monstre/monster: Latin monstrum node reused; modern French/English senses independent.
presser/pression: premere base reused; intensive verb versus deverbal noun remain separate.
recognize/reconnaître: recognoscere transmission sources reused; gratitude and specialized English usage distinguished.
lumen/lux: same lexicographic resource reused; noun identities and semantic inventories independent. No measured time-savings claim.
